title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers. In this paper, we propose a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning. Data quality is formulated as a continuous confidence estimation problem rather than a binary anomaly identification task, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison. translated_title: 基于领域知识与图结构学习的置信度材料数据质量评估
translated_abstract: 材料机器学习的快速发展依赖于大规模、异构的数据集，然而来自不同实验、模拟和数据库整合的不完善数据往往会损害模型的可靠性。现实中的材料数据库可能包含测量误差、失败的计算、缺失或重复的记录，以及隐藏的物理化学约束违反。这些问题难以识别，因为受损的样本可能在统计上仍然合理，而不是表现为明显的异常值。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于置信度的材料数据质量评估框架，该框架将领域知识与图结构学习相结合。数据质量被表述为一个连续的置信度估计问题，而非二元的异常识别任务，从而实现样本级评估和基于历史参考的批次比较。九维特征质量先验和重复（注：原文摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合领域知识与图结构学习的置信度材料数据质量评估框架，将数据质量建模为连续置信度估计而非二元异常识别，实现了样本级评估和基于历史参考的批次比较。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning, formulating data quality as continuous confidence estimation rather than binary anomaly identification, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison.
